snapshot_note: A published snapshot, not a live read. Directories change continuously and indexing lags: absence from this snapshot is NOT absence from a directory. Only 'listed: false' from an exact scoped check (basis 'scoped') or the fleet matrix is a directory read that found nothing at snapshot time — and even that can lag.

cdp.label: CDP Bazaar
cdp.coverage: Bounded slice: the first 1000 of 94152 resources in the global discovery feed, plus exact scoped checks (merchant / listing-status / q=host reads) for the fleet and 23 census origins. Presence outside the slice is covered only where a scoped check ran.

payai.label: PayAI
payai.coverage: Bounded slice: the first 1000 of 24023 resources in the global discovery feed, plus exact scoped checks (merchant / listing-status / q=host reads) for the fleet and 23 census origins. Presence outside the slice is covered only where a scoped check ran.

settled.label: Settled
settled.coverage: Bounded slice: the first 1000 of 97283 resources in the global discovery feed, plus exact scoped checks (merchant / listing-status / q=host reads) for the fleet and 23 census origins. Presence outside the slice is covered only where a scoped check ran.

x402scan.label: x402scan
x402scan.coverage: No global feed read exists on x402scan. Presence is recorded only where a recipient page was actually fetched and carried resource records under the checked origin: the fleet (exact, from the catalogue-watch matrix) and scoped-checked payTos. Every other entry is 'not covered' for x402scan — never 'absent'.

limits: CDP/PayAI/Settled presence comes from a bounded feed slice (see per-source feed_resources_read / feed_total_resources) plus exact scoped checks for the fleet and a bounded set of census origins.
x402scan has no global feed read; it is covered only for the fleet and scoped-checked payTos.
PayAI scoped counts count listing-status answers for up to 2 of the origin's resources, not the origin's whole catalogue.
One entry per payTo (an origin paying several payTos appears once per payTo); origin-only entries carry payTo=null.
